summary: Paul Nahon, 24, fell about 150 feet from The Narrows on the Keyhole Route on Longs Peak and suffered traumatic injuries; an off-duty park volunteer with a radio descended to the man with his climbing party and began CPR, but he succumbed to his injuries; helicopter body recovery was postponed to the next day due to high winds; ice was present at several locations along the route.
location: The Narrows, Keyhole Route, Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry dated 2013-08-16 (Thursday-verified); recovery completed 2013-08-18 per the follow-up entry.
